authority_note: Cases specify evidence to collect locally. No case has been executed by this handoff. Refine provisional behavior deliberately and update the prose and machine-readable specifications together.

evidence_levels.compiler: Pure parser/compiler/reactive logic, with deterministic inputs.
evidence_levels.emitted_artifact: Execute or inspect real generated HTML/CSS/JS and resource publication.
evidence_levels.browser: Real browser execution, DOM identity, lifetimes and native interaction.
evidence_levels.browser_network: Browser asset requests against the emitted application.
evidence_levels.visual_review: Representative layout, typography, focus and interaction states.
evidence_levels.installed_distribution: Normal built/installed zfb artifact, not mocked engine calls.
evidence_levels.manual_ime: Actual OS Japanese input method on a supported user platform; report separately from synthetic events.

cases.title: Deterministic supported output
cases.setup: Same explicit candidates and config with varied traversal/insertion order.
cases.action: Compile repeatedly; include invalid recognized explicit candidates.
cases.expected: Identical CSS and explanation output; structured diagnostics include origin.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Padding conflict behavior
cases.setup: spacingUnit=0.25rem; element with p-4 px-2 pl-1.
cases.action: Permute class order and inspect actual computed styles.
cases.expected: Top/bottom=1rem; right=0.5rem; left=0.25rem for every permutation.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: States, breakpoints, and layers
cases.setup: State utilities, breakpoint, root/descendant dark, component layer and unlayered CSS.
cases.action: Cross media thresholds and states; compile one unsupported variant combination.
cases.expected: Specified cascade, hover capability and dark behavior; useful rejection of unsupported grammar.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Source deletion and duplicate ownership
cases.setup: Same candidate owned by two files; generated manifest and safelist cases.
cases.action: Remove each contribution; replace manifest; rename/delete/add matched files; compare clean/warm builds.
cases.expected: Rule survives until its last owner is removed; discovered inputs and output converge deterministically.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Hidden client state and authored classes
cases.setup: Complete class literal used only after interaction; ordinary authored class; collision allowlist.
cases.action: Build then enter client-only state; inspect diagnostics and styling.
cases.expected: Static literal is covered; authored class remains valid; dynamic construction is never falsely claimed as covered.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: CSS assets and imports
cases.setup: Project and package CSS with nested imports and relative images/fonts, plus external/data URLs.
cases.action: Build with actual base path, minification and hashing; request emitted assets.
cases.expected: Origin-relative URLs and required assets remain correct; source provenance and cascade survive.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Reset and ordinary CSS
cases.setup: Native controls, headings/lists, keyboard focus, border utility, CSS Modules/global CSS.
cases.action: Check minimal-v1 exact fixture and reset:none.
cases.expected: Only specified reset behavior occurs; no accidental dependence on omitted preflight; authored CSS is published.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Installed distribution and process boundary
cases.setup: Built/installed zfb and chosen consumer; legacy executable unavailable or process observation enabled.
cases.action: Run normal build and inspect resulting page/assets.
cases.expected: New wind path invokes no Tailwind; actual new engine runs; required esbuild paths still work.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Server determinism and isolation
cases.setup: Same component/data and separate requests, escaping and supported element cases.
cases.expected: Deterministic context-scoped boundaries, no shared request state, correct escaping, no browser activation.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Real DOM adoption
cases.setup: Emitted SSR HTML with adjacent/empty text, fragments and two islands; retain node references.
cases.action: Load emitted client bundle and hydrate.
cases.expected: Existing owned nodes retain identity; markers disambiguate slots; clearing/recreating the tree fails the case.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Reactive semantics
cases.setup: Signals/computeds, .value snapshots, reactive props, conditional/diamond dependencies, and a boolean-hidden panel with authored hiding CSS plus flex/grid.
cases.action: Write state, batch updates, await the defined flush, count setup executions, and toggle the panel with both utility and ordinary authored display CSS.
cases.expected: Live bindings update, snapshots remain snapshots, setup runs once, and dependency/scheduling semantics match the spec. The inactive panel computes display:none, then recovers its intended layout when shown; no zudo-wind runtime dependency.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Events, refs, and activation
cases.setup: Native events, refs, activation callbacks and scoped async work.
cases.action: Activate, interact and request duplicate activation through zfb.
cases.expected: Refs precede activation; events behave natively; no duplicate resources; errors/cancellation follow scope ownership.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Forms before hydration
cases.setup: Uncontrolled and model-bound text/textarea/checkbox; additional control adapters only if supported.
cases.action: Edit before delayed hydration, hydrate, programmatically update, reset/cancel reset.
cases.expected: Live DOM is preserved; models reconcile before writes; subsequent updates/reset follow adapter policy; unsupported bindings fail.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Composition and focus
cases.setup: Editable supported model binding, including hydration during possible composition.
cases.action: Exercise synthetic composition/input events and a separate real Japanese IME pass.
cases.expected: No destructive writes during composition; final edit policy holds; focus/selection preserved within supported operations; evidence types distinct.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Disposal and cancellation
cases.setup: Active widget owns subscription/listener/timer cleanup; deferred island import is pending.
cases.action: Dispose twice; remove deferred island before import settles; fail preflight.
cases.expected: Cleanup exactly once, no observable post-disposal work, no late activation or failed-adoption resources.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Mismatch and version rejection
cases.setup: Incompatible protocol/build identity, malformed props or structural mismatch plus healthy neighboring root.
cases.expected: Useful diagnosis before activation; original DOM/user state retained; provisional graph released; neighboring root independent.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: zfb navigation ownership
cases.setup: Actual zfb navigation with disposable, persisted and changed-props islands.
cases.expected: Removed work released; persisted DOM/state retained without duplicate mount; changed props follow explicit recreate policy.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

cases.title: Structural regions when required
cases.setup: Implemented conditional region/keyed list with focused input and scope-owned work.
cases.action: Toggle, reorder, remove, re-add and supply duplicate keys.
cases.expected: Declared identity and disposal hold; focus follows retained keyed item; invalid keys diagnosed. Unsupported operations cannot count as migrated.
cases.applicability: Required for each structural operation included in the selected consumer contract. Otherwise record deliberately unsupported.

cases.title: Runtime identity and generated integration
cases.setup: Retained shared/per-island outputs, nested component and supported workspace consumer.
cases.action: Build/load actual generated modules and hydrate.
cases.expected: JSX factories, branding, server/client protocols and package identity agree; no duplicate singleton or stale alias path.
cases.applicability: Required for the corresponding supported rollout scope.

performance_note: Record a current same-environment baseline and repeated measurements before claims. No performance targets or results are supplied.
